tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// ba ri ba'i chos skor gyi brgyud 'debs bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gis byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas// grangs med gsum du brtson pas rab bsgrubs pas// tshogs gnyis mthar phyin rang gzhan don brnyes pa// ston pa bder gshegs rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes bla na med// gcig tu bsdus pa rgyal sras gzhon nu'i tshul// shes rab ral gri utpal 'dzin brtson pa// mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// khyod ni shes bya kun la rab sbyangs nas// ting 'dzin brtson pas go 'phang mchog brnyes te// gzhan gyi don la gcig tu rab gzhol ba// dgra las rnam par rgyal ba'i zhabs la 'dud// bde gshegs bstan pa'i gsung rab rin chen gyis// thugs kyi bang mdzod rab tu bltams byas nas// chos kyi sbyin pas sems can tshim mdzad pa// rdo rje gdan pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba'i rigs 'khrungs byams pa'i thugs dang ldan// tshul khrims gzugs bzang yon tan rgyan gyis spras// brtse bas 'gro la ma nor lam ston pa// rdo rje gdan pa gnyis pa'i zhabs la 'dud// byang sems sa bon snying rje'i chu yis bskyed// yon tan ljon shing rtogs pa'i 'bras bu can// gzhan don bsdu ba'i bsil grib dang ldan pa// rin chen grags pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jam dbyangs ye shes nyi ma'i gsung zer gyis// mkhyen pa padmo'i tshal rab rgyas byas nas// legs bshad sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston dgyes mdzad pa// rje btsun sa skya pa la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro ba 'di kun bu gcig ltar gzigs pas// skyo ba med par gzhan gyi don brtson pa// rgyal sras thu bo 'jig rten kun gyi rje// dpal ldan rtse mo'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// khyod thugs srid pa'i 'ching las rnam grol yang*// brtse bas srid par skye ba'i tshul bstan pas// skye dgu kun gyi 'dren pa mchog gyur pa// rnal 'byor dbang phyug rgyal mtshan zhabs la 'dud// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku// gcig tu bsdus pa dpal ldan chos kyi rje// gzhan gyi don du skye bo'i skur ston pa// ye shes dbang phyug zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// mgon po khyod kyi cho 'phrul gsum mnyes pas// gdul bya kun gyi mos pa ji bzhin du// rnam 'phrul du mas yongs su tshim mdzad pa// mdzad pa mtha' yas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// stobs bcu'i stobs dang yang dag rab ldan pas// bdud kyi stobs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad cing*// gdul bya'i byang chub lam kun rdzogs mdzad pa// bsam yas mthu ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// khyod ni gzungs dang ting 'dzin rmad byung dang*// mi 'jigs yang dag rig la dbang 'byor pas// the tshom drwa ba kun nas 'grol mdzad pa// ston mchog khyod la rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo// ma 'dres yon tan drug phrag gsum ldan pas// lhar bcas 'jig rten kun gyi skyabs gyur cing*// 'phags pa'i tshogs kyi bla ma mchog gyur pa// 'dren mchog khyod la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// mtshungs med bla ma'i mchog rab de dag la// rtag tu gus pas bdag ni skyabs su mchi// rkang gi khong nas rab tu gsol ba 'debs// rnam pa kun tu bdag la byin gyis rlobs// nye bar bkod dang bdag pos ma bzung dang*// yid kyis sprul dang bla na med pa yi// mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po mtha' yas pas// bla ma'i tshogs dang dkon mchog mchod par bgyi// sdig pa 'gyod cing sdom pa'i sems kyis bshags// dge ba ma lus pa la yi rangs shing*// bla med chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// rtag tu mya ngan mi 'da' gsol ba 'debs// dge ba 'di dang dge ba'i rtsa ba gzhan// ma lus blo yis gcig tu bsdoms byas nas// mkha' mnyam sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par shog

/skye dang skye ba dag ni thams cad du// yon tan bdun ldan lha mi'i lus thob nas// dpal ldan bla ma mchog dang mi 'bral zhing*// rtag tu de nyid mnyes pa'ang byed par shog /de yi gsung las theg mchog zab mo'i don// thos shing khong du chud par byas nas kyang*// gsang sngags rgya mtsho'i spyod pa ji snyed pa// gegs med par yang ci bder spyod par shog /skad cig re re la'ang phyogs bcu yi// zhing rnams kun tu sangs rgyas thams cad las// dam chos rgya mtsho thos shing de dag gi /ye shes gzigs pa'i dam pa 'jug gyur cig /sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las rgya mtsho dang*// rgyal sras mchog gi mdzad pa rgya mtsho dang*// bdag gi byang chub spyod pa 'dres gyur nas// sems can thams cad smin par byed par shog /de ltar byang chub lam gyi spyod pa kun// thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byas nas kyang*// rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes rgya mtsho dang*// rnam pa kun tu ro gcig gyur par shog /skye ba 'di nyid du yang tshe ring zhing*// nad med pa dang longs spyod phun sum tshogs// bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi ba dang*// yid la 'dod pa thams cad 'grub gyur cig /tshul 'di ni dpal ldan bla ma chos kyi rje sa skya paṇḍi ta chen po'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa'i btsun pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos shing pho stag gi lo bya sbo'i tshes bco lnga la mdo khams sgang du sbyar ba'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
